label: UniFi LTE Backup Pro
description: UniFi LTE Backup Pro - a failover modem for a UniFi gateway: two GbE RJ45 ports (one powered by PoE-in, one passing PoE through) and an LTE Cat 4 radio with an internal antenna pair plus an RP-SMA connector for an external one.
notes: Vendor figures from Ubiquiti techspecs: (2) GbE RJ45 ports - one PoE in, one PoE passthrough output requiring a PoE source - and an LTE Category 4 radio with (2) internal antennas and (1) female RP-SMA connector for an external antenna. Max power consumption 8.5 W excluding PoE passthrough. The LTE interface is modelled at 100M, the Cat 4 class shared with every other Cat 4 device in the catalogue, because the datasheet names the category rather than a measured rate.
